concerns.text: T008 includes a fallback to 'generate_synthetic_*()' or 'mock_*()' data if fetch fails. This violates FR-001 (ingest real data) and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) by allowing the deliverable to be synthetic data, which is a semantic weakening of the requirement for real-call testing.

T009 states it 'reduces SC-001 validity' if computed-only datasets are found. This is a silent weakening of the Success Criterion. SC-001 requires a specific MAE target against experimental noise; the task should reframe the success criteria or halt, not 'reduce validity' of the requirement itself.

T025 is marked as 'rejected' (unchecked) in the task list. FR-007 explicitly requires masking attribution weights for redundant subgraphs. Without T025, the deliverable for FR-007 is incomplete, violating the requirement to prevent spurious independent effect claims.

T027 is marked as 'rejected' (unchecked). It is the designated task to aggregate all metrics (MAE, collinearity, power status) into the single `metrics.json` file. Without this, the 'Single Source of Truth' (Constitution Principle IV) is not produced, and downstream tasks cannot verify the full set of success criteria.

T034 is marked as 'rejected' (unchecked). It enforces the 'fail loud' policy to prevent silent fallback to synthetic data. Without this task, the implementation of T008 remains vulnerable to the semantic weakening identified in T008, leaving the constraint preservation of FR-001 unverified.

T036 is marked as 'rejected' (unchecked). It implements the aggregation of subgraphs with latent cosine similarity > 0.9. This is a specific implementation detail of FR-007. Without it, the 'masking' requirement in FR-007 is only partially implemented (detection exists, aggregation/masking logic is missing).
